content: In TPiL when hovering over #eval or #check the command docstring is not shown. Where is this configured? I'm having an issue where the docstring for these is covering the result.
Hi @Chris Henson , David is on holidays but he pointed out that there is no place to configure this. Maybe worth submitting an issue so we don't forget to address this?
It seems like TPiL just is built with an older version of Lean/Verso where this problem does not yet occur in this form. I created the issue.
Thanks for opening the issue, I'd stalled because I was trying to figure out exactly why this didn't happen in TPiL.

What I can say for sure is that in a fresh project with the Lean toolchain and Verso revision from TPiL (v4.27.0-rc1 and ea44a4d919a4570055bf53171ea4d8a8919cde84), and no further configuration, the Manual genre produces no docstring popups for #eval. Just popups for the values, as in TPiL. Apart from that I only took a cursory look at TPiL itself. It seemed to mostly only contain the content itself and little to no code that alters/extends the genre.
